verdicts.reason: Both are essentially the same broken layout. The two hero pasta photos have shrunk to thumbnails and sit in a scattered 2x3 grid with empty frames, a stray peach block and detached frame borders. The decorative pasta pattern takes up a huge block while the real food imagery is trivial. The ornamental frame and dividers are broken into fragments, and the plate illustration is cut off and overlaps a divider. The only good part of either is the headline, brand name and URL text at the top and bottom, and B's headline is shifted down a few pixels, which makes no meaningful difference.
